rules.R1_no_name: Unnamed, or a generic/placeholder name (path, trail, unnamed, a bare number) without an official ID
rules.R2_too_short: Under 0.3 mi, unless an official-layer trail or a named loop inside a park
rules.R3_sidewalk: Sidewalk, crosswalk, driveway, parking aisle, golf-cart path, steps only, or a street-name sidepath
rules.R4_indoor: Indoor, building passage, airport or campus service path
rules.R5_road: A road mapped as a trail (motor vehicles allowed on a track with a road name)
rules.R6_private_closed: Private or no access, disused/abandoned/under construction, or closed/decommissioned in the official layer
rules.R7_duplicate: Duplicate of another record (same name within 2 km with overlapping line); the record with more sources is kept
rules.R8_degenerate: Degenerate geometry: fewer than 3 points, self-intersecting zig-zags, or a scribble (length far exceeds its extent)
rules.R9_climbing: Climbing approach or descent path not part of a named route relation
rules.R10_outside: Outside every country/region outline (open water), or outside its claimed state/province
